# decideR

`decideR` is the shared Bayesian decision layer of the ORCHESTRA
analytics framework. It maps a posterior into an action under an
explicit utility and a hard feasibility constraint, returning the action
together with a grounding label and an abstention when the evidence will
not support a decision. The grounding label is combined worst-case
across inputs, so a decision resting on an unverified external fact is
downgraded to abstention – the Independent Oracle Principle – rather
than asserted with false confidence.

The same engine sizes a crop nitrogen rate and a trading position,
because both are the same problem: act under uncertainty, and refuse to
act when the evidence will not support it.

As the **tail of an ORCHESTRA pipeline** it decides directly from an
upstream member’s `orchestra_manifest` – a PESTO inversion, a kernR
causal test, a flexyBayes posterior – via
[`decide_from_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_from_manifest.md),
reading the predictive draws and the producer’s grounding token off the
contract without depending on the contract package. Its loss library
includes a **grade-band loss**
([`grade_band_value()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/grade_band_value.md))
that prices quality-threshold payoffs – a grain price that steps up as
protein clears a milling and a premium band – as a first-class step
value schedule.

## Related packages

- [decisionSupport](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=decisionSupport)
  chooses between two alternatives by expected welfare from Monte Carlo
  simulation, and uses value-of-information analysis to decide which
  uncertainties are worth reducing.
- [BCEA](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=BCEA) takes cost and
  effectiveness draws for two or more interventions, for example MCMC
  output from a Bayesian model, and finds the most cost-effective one
  with probabilistic sensitivity analysis.
- [voi](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=voi) calculates the expected
  value of perfect, partial and sample information from a decision
  model.

decideR also starts from posterior draws, but chooses from a range of
actions (a nitrogen rate, a position size) under an explicit utility and
a hard constraint, can price stepped payoffs such as grain protein
bands, and abstains instead of deciding when an input is not grounded.

## Installation

``` r

pak::pak("max578/decideR")
```

## Example

The two reference decisions, from two domains, both route through the
one engine.

``` r

library(decideR)

# A crop decision: choose the nitrogen rate of greatest expected profit, given
# posterior yield draws at each candidate rate.
rates <- seq(0, 200, by = 25)
ymax  <- rnorm(2000L, 5.5, 0.3)
yield_draws <- vapply(rates,
  function(r) 3 + (ymax - 3) * (1 - exp(-r / 80)) + rnorm(2000L, 0, 0.1),
  numeric(2000L))
decide_input_rate(yield_draws, rates, price_grain = 300, price_input = 1.2,
                  grounding = grounding_grounded())
#> <decision> decided  [grounded]
#>   action : rate=175
#>   E[utility]: 1356
#>   candidates: 9 evaluated (method: expected_profit)

# A trading decision: size a position by drawdown-capped expected log-growth.
# An un-grounded price feed forces flat -- the capital firewall.
returns <- rnorm(5000L, 0.02, 0.03)
decide_position_size(returns, capital = 1000, max_drawdown = 0.15,
                     grounding = grounding_unverified())
#> <decision> ABSTAINED (input_ungrounded)  [ungrounded]
#>   action : flat (0%) [ungrounded]
#>   candidates: 41 evaluated (method: kelly_log_growth_drawdown_capped)

# A quality-graded payoff: protein bands price the decision, not the mean.
protein_value <- grade_band_value(breaks = c(11.5, 13.0),
                                  values = c(300, 360, 420))
protein_value
#> <grade_band_value> 3 bands
#>          band value
#>  [-Inf, 11.5)   300
#>    [11.5, 13)   360
#>     [13, Inf)   420
```

See
[`vignette("getting-started")`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/articles/getting-started.md)
for the full walk-through, including the manifest-native pipeline tail
and the grade-band loss worked end to end.

# Package index

## Decisions

The core engine and the two reference decisions built on it.

- [`decide()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide.md) :
  Choose an action by expected utility, with grounding and abstention
- [`decide_input_rate()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_input_rate.md)
  : Choose a crop input rate by expected profit
- [`decide_position_size()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_position_size.md)
  : Size a trading position by capped expected log-growth under a
  loss-quantile limit
- [`decision()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decision.md)
  : A decision-theoretic action with grounding and abstention
- [`is_grounded()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/is_grounded.md)
  : Is a decision grounded?
- [`print,decideR::decision-method`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/print-decideR-decision-method.md)
  : Print a decision

## Manifest tail

Deciding directly from an upstream `orchestra_manifest`.

- [`decide_from_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_from_manifest.md)
  : Turn an orchestra manifest into a decision
- [`decide_rate_from_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_rate_from_manifest.md)
  : Choose a crop input rate from an upstream yield manifest

## Value

Value of information (EVPI, EVSI) and the discounted benefit-cost ratio.

- [`bcr_crrdc()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/bcr_crrdc.md)
  : CRRDC-guideline benefit-cost ratio
- [`decide_bcr()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_bcr.md)
  : Benefit-cost ratio of a research investment
- [`decide_evpi()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_evpi.md)
  : Expected value of perfect information from a manifest
- [`decide_evsi()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/decide_evsi.md)
  : Expected value of one prospective sample from a manifest
- [`print,decideR::valuation-method`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/print-decideR-valuation-method.md)
  : Print a valuation
- [`valuation()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/valuation.md)
  : A priced quantity with grounding and abstention
- [`print(`*`<decider_bcr>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/print.decider_bcr.md)
  : Print a CRRDC benefit-cost ratio
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<decider_bcr>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/as.data.frame.decider_bcr.md)
  : Coerce a CRRDC benefit-cost ratio to a data.frame

## Grounding

The Independent Oracle Principle provenance vocabulary.

- [`combine_grounding()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/combine_grounding.md)
  : Combine input grounding worst-case
- [`grounding_grounded()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/grounding_tokens.md)
  [`grounding_unverified()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/grounding_tokens.md)
  : Canonical grounding tokens

## Loss

Threshold-economics (grade-band) loss primitives.

- [`grade_band_utility()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/grade_band_utility.md)
  : Build a decide() utility from a grade-band schedule
- [`grade_band_value()`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/grade_band_value.md)
  : A grade-band value schedule (threshold-economics loss)
- [`print(`*`<grade_band_value>`*`)`](https://max578.github.io/decideR/reference/print.grade_band_value.md)
  : Print a grade-band value schedule
